question: Which country has the highest freedom to make choices index? What region is it from?
query: SELECT country_name, regional_indicator, MAX(freedom_to_make_life_choices) AS max_freedom_index FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY country_name, regional_indicator ORDER BY max_freedom_index DESC LIMIT 1;
raw_results:
| country_name | regional_indicator | max_freedom_index |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Uzbekistan | Commonwealth of Independent States | 0.985177755 |
